imageStyles.base: AMAZON VISUAL SYSTEM — Use a clean catalogue composition: one product, centered, large but with generous white breathing room, true-to-life neutral light, accurate color and restrained natural shadow. No filters, props, decorative graphics, badges, text, comparison collage, price, or lifestyle background.
imageStyles.lifestyle: AMAZON LIFESTYLE — Show one practical, believable use situation in a tidy home, desk, kitchen or work setting. Keep the product dominant and fully readable; use neutral daylight, a limited prop count and calm colors. The image should explain use, not look like an editorial campaign or a crowded room.
imageStyles.model: AMAZON HUMAN USE — Show an adult using, wearing or holding the product in a calm, credible way. Product recognition is more important than fashion, face or pose. Use an uncluttered real setting, neutral clothing and no exaggerated lifestyle styling.
imageStyles.feature: AMAZON FEATURE CARD — Minimal factual detail-page layout: one product close-up, abundant whitespace and at most a few short English words. Use neutral white or light gray support areas. Never use unverified performance numbers, certification seals, comparison claims, star ratings, price language or loud promotional graphics.
imageStyles.detail: AMAZON DETAIL COMPOSITE — Create 2–4 evenly spaced close-up panels on white or very pale gray. Show only real, visible construction details. Keep panel borders subtle, lighting neutral and product geometry easy to inspect; no glow effects, arrows, labels or busy decoration.
imageStyles.package: AMAZON PACKAGE VIEW — A factual catalogue flat lay. Align the real product, verified box and only visible accessories on a clean white background with equal spacing. If package references are absent, use the product and one unbranded concept box only; do not imply included items.

imageStyles.base: ALIEXPRESS VISUAL SYSTEM — Use a close, high-clarity commercial product composition. The product may fill more of the frame than Amazon, with crisp edge contrast and a simple clean background. Keep the image direct and energetic, but do not add price, discount, countdown, marketplace logo, badge or distracting decoration.
imageStyles.lifestyle: ALIEXPRESS LIFESTYLE — Build a clear benefit-led scene where the product use is obvious on first glance. Use a tighter crop, brighter color contrast and a practical setting with only a few relevant props. The product must remain large, visible and physically believable.
imageStyles.model: ALIEXPRESS HUMAN USE — Use a purposeful action such as holding, wearing, opening or operating the product. Frame product and action tightly; make the use case obvious before the person. Do not turn the image into a fashion portrait or a vague aspirational scene.
imageStyles.feature: ALIEXPRESS FEATURE CARD — Use a compact commercial layout with a strong product close-up and clear short English text only when confirmed. One visual focus per area; light callouts are allowed only for visible facts. Never invent specifications, certifications, compatibility, discounts or superiority claims.
imageStyles.detail: ALIEXPRESS DETAIL COMPOSITE — Use 2–4 close, high-contrast panels with distinct real details. The layout can be denser than Amazon but must remain clean and legible. Each panel needs a different visible feature; no duplicate crops, invented internals or excessive visual effects.
imageStyles.package: ALIEXPRESS PACKAGE VIEW — Use clear zones for product, verified box and visible accessories. The arrangement may be compact and commercial, but every object must be supported by a reference image. If no package reference exists, show only a generic unbranded box concept without claiming contents.

imageStyles.base: MERCADO LIBRE VISUAL SYSTEM — Make the product feel real, bright and immediately understandable. Use a centered, honest product view with daylight-like light, natural color and a clean white background. Avoid futuristic lighting, luxury editorial styling, dramatic shadows, heavy retouching or abstract props.
imageStyles.lifestyle: MERCADO LIBRE LIFESTYLE — Place the product in an everyday, well-lit home or practical setting that quickly explains where and how it is used. The scene should feel friendly, authentic and achievable; keep the product larger than the surrounding environment.
imageStyles.model: MERCADO LIBRE HUMAN USE — Use a friendly, ordinary adult user in a clear everyday action. Natural expression and understandable use matter more than fashion. Keep the product clearly visible and avoid staged luxury poses or dark cinematic treatment.
imageStyles.feature: MERCADO LIBRE FEATURE CARD — Prefer real product structure and a plain, readable explanation over visual spectacle. Use bright white space, short verified English if needed, and clear product close-ups. Do not add technical effects, unverifiable claims, aggressive sales language or dense information blocks.
imageStyles.detail: MERCADO LIBRE DETAIL COMPOSITE — Create 2–4 bright, direct detail panels that prioritize understandable structure. Use simple separation, realistic light and clear material texture. No mystery lighting, hidden features, glossy effects or decorative collage elements.
imageStyles.package: MERCADO LIBRE PACKAGE VIEW — Present a believable real unboxing arrangement: clean, bright and verifiable. Only show the supplied product, visible package and visible accessories. When packaging is unknown, show a modest generic box concept without a contents list.

imageStyles.base: TEMU VISUAL SYSTEM — Design for fast mobile scanning: make the product very large, high contrast and readable at thumbnail size. Use a simple bright background and a straightforward front or three-quarter angle. Do not add price, discount, coupon, countdown, platform logo, promotional sticker or small unreadable decoration.
imageStyles.lifestyle: TEMU LIFESTYLE — Use one fast-to-read practical scene with a simplified background, bright natural light and product-first framing. The first glance must reveal the use case. Keep props few, colors clear and the product visually larger than the scene context.
imageStyles.model: TEMU HUMAN USE — Use a tight, natural moment of holding, wearing or using the product to communicate scale and function immediately. Product and hand/body relationship must be unmistakable. Avoid distant full-body fashion shots, moody lighting or busy locations.
imageStyles.feature: TEMU FEATURE CARD — One image should communicate one visually supported point. Use large, simple English only if it is factual and readable on a phone. Avoid small type, lengthy copy, prices, promotional urgency, unverified metrics, certification marks and decorative infographic clutter.
imageStyles.detail: TEMU DETAIL COMPOSITE — Use 2–4 high-contrast detail panels with strong spacing and clear boundaries for mobile viewing. Every panel must be readable at small size and show a different visible feature. Do not use tiny labels, thin decorative lines or invented internal details.
imageStyles.package: TEMU PACKAGE VIEW — Make the product and verified components easy to scan: compact grouping, bright background and obvious separation. Never add coupons, promotional inserts, accessories or quantities that are not in the reference. Without package proof, use only a neutral box concept.

imageStyles.base: SHOPEE VISUAL SYSTEM — Use a bright, approachable everyday retail image. Keep the product clear, colorful but natural, and easy to recognize on a mobile screen. Use a simple clean background and avoid harsh filters, luxury drama, price labels, badges or platform branding.
imageStyles.lifestyle: SHOPEE LIFESTYLE — Create a warm everyday home, commute or personal-use scene with natural daylight and a tidy background. The mood may feel friendly and lived-in, but the product must remain more noticeable than the environment.
imageStyles.model: SHOPEE HUMAN USE — Show relaxed, believable daily use by an adult. The person should make the product feel accessible rather than aspirational; use natural posture, light color and a clear relationship to the item. Avoid editorial posing or implausible use.
imageStyles.feature: SHOPEE FEATURE CARD — Use a light, friendly English feature layout with clear hierarchy and restrained copy. Support the message with a real close-up. Do not make it a dense advertising poster, and never invent specifications, numbers, certificates or before/after claims.
imageStyles.detail: SHOPEE DETAIL COMPOSITE — Present 2–4 real detail panels on bright, clean backgrounds with visible texture and natural material rendering. Maintain clear edges and comfortable whitespace; avoid exaggerated glow, dark drama or duplicate crops.
imageStyles.package: SHOPEE PACKAGE VIEW — Use an easy-to-understand, friendly unboxing arrangement. Relationships between verified objects should be obvious and tidy. Without package references, produce only a generic product box concept and no confirmed accessory list.

imageStyles.base: SHEIN VISUAL SYSTEM — Use an editorial but product-faithful image: soft natural light, refined material texture and intentional composition. For apparel, shoes and bags, a portrait-oriented crop is acceptable; for other goods, recognition remains first. Avoid hard catalogue flash, heavy filters, overt discount graphics or artificial luxury effects.
imageStyles.lifestyle: SHEIN LIFESTYLE — Create an aesthetically considered daily scene with soft natural light, gentle tonal layers and enough environmental texture to feel editorial. The product silhouette and material must stay clear. Avoid clutter, unrealistic fantasy rooms or a generic empty studio backdrop.
imageStyles.model: SHEIN HUMAN USE — Use a natural street-style or at-home moment with an adult, where the product is genuinely integrated into the outfit or activity. The pose should feel unstaged and tactile; preserve product shape, hardware, graphics and proportions exactly.
imageStyles.feature: SHEIN FEATURE CARD — Use generous whitespace, tactile close-up imagery and a restrained short English phrase only when supported by the reference. It should read like an editorial detail, not a hard-sell advert. Never add false fabric, performance, size, certification or promotional claims.
imageStyles.detail: SHEIN DETAIL COMPOSITE — Create 2–4 coordinated editorial detail panels focused on real texture, stitching, hardware, closure, interface or craft. Use consistent soft light, clean margins and a unified palette. Do not fabricate hidden construction or overload the image with text and effects.
imageStyles.package: SHEIN PACKAGE VIEW — Use a considered lifestyle flat lay with tactile texture and calm styling, while remaining factual. Show only verified product, package and accessories. Without references, use an unbranded concept box without implying a real set or contents list.
